title: My Daughter Forged The Dissolution, Sold My Pianos For $750K, Mailed Me $4,300. So I Voided It
description: At 59, I used $126,000 of my school custodian pension to open a piano restoration studio with my daughter, and she forged a dissolution to sell my restored Steinways for $750,000. I found the original notarized agreement inside a 1903 upright and voided the sale. Now she restrings pianos in a smock that says Struck a False Note while every tuning certificate prints her fraud docket. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #PianoRestoration
thumb_text: I VOIDED HER $750K SALE WITH ONE PAPER
pinned_comment: What would you do if your daughter forged a dissolution, sold your restored Steinways for $750,000, and mailed you a $4,300 damper check after you gave her 45 percent of your piano studio? Share your story in the comments.
